description: Get a prioritized market signal brief for an industry vertical, built from signals you supply. $24 per brief. Returns a checkout_url and order_id; after payment call ni_order_status with order_id to get the result.

signals.description: Optional raw signals (news, posts, notes) to brief from, up to 6000 characters. Without it, the brief is written from general knowledge of the vertical.

name: ni_signaldesk_brief
